_comment: v0 starter set (outline §3.2, build_plan.md Phase 2). Deliberately small and diverse across the target domains (§10: robotics, AV, indoor/embodied) plus two prompts chosen to stress specific physics phenomena (fluids, rigid contact) rather than just look visually plausible. Expand once real runs surface which prompts are actually informative.

prompts.prompt: A robot arm picks up a red cube from a table and places it into a bin.
A car approaches a busy four-way intersection with pedestrians crossing.
A first-person view walking through a cluttered living room, avoiding furniture.
Water is poured from a pitcher into a glass on a kitchen counter.
A bowling ball rolls down a lane and strikes a set of pins, scattering them.
A flag and nearby trees sway in strong wind on a hilltop.
